evidence.detail: The class owns multiple AudioEnvelope instances for pitch/volume and modulation stages, oscillator/delay parameter arrays, one AudioFilter and its control envelope.
Its synthesis method produces an int[] sample buffer by stepping envelopes, combining oscillators, applying delay/echo-like state and then applying the decoded AudioFilter coefficients.
Its Stream decoder reconstructs one complete synthesized tone/instrument definition including optional modulation/envelope sections and filter state.
rs/w/e owns up to ten rs/w/d instances and mixes their generated samples into one sound effect buffer.

evidence.detail: The class decodes paired filter-stage coefficients and gain/interpolation parameters, computes coefficient tables using pow/sine math and a 11025-Hz frequency basis, and exposes per-channel coefficient counts.
rs/w/d owns exactly one rs/w/b plus a dedicated rs/w/a control envelope and applies the generated filter coefficients across synthesized sample buffers.
No MIDI/device/file behavior exists; the class is the coefficient-producing audio filter used by the synthesized instrument path.

evidence.detail: The class owns javax.sound.midi Sequence, Sequencer and Synthesizer state, opens/loads sequences, starts/stops playback and accesses MIDI channels.
Volume changes are applied through MIDI channel controller 7 when synthesizer channels are available and through MASTER_GAIN-compatible mixer controls as a fallback.
Exact-v308 references include Client and the signlink/runtime helper rs/v/a, establishing live client music playback rather than a dormant utility.
This class is separate from the rs/w/a,b,d,e PCM synthesis stack and specifically owns Java MIDI sequencing/playback.

evidence.detail: The class decodes and owns an array of up to ten SoundInstrument records plus effect start/end timing fields.
It requests PCM samples from each instrument, mixes them into a shared byte/sample buffer, and exposes the result through a Stream suitable for the client audio path.
The class maintains the decoded sound-effect registry/static sample workspace and loads effect definitions from the exact-v308 Stream format.
Client references this effect container directly, establishing it as the live synthesized sound-effect asset path.

evidence.detail: The class decodes envelope form/start/end plus breakpoint duration/amplitude arrays from Stream, resets interpolation counters, and produces a stepped/interpolated integer value for each synthesis sample.
